name: Add Github Plugin
description:
Add a github plugin. This plugin will link a github PR to a story

- Stories will contain a "Github PR" field when plugin is enabled.
- Update rowbly factory and dev skills so they update this wheneer a PR for a story is opened.
- Use the `gh` cli to periodically fetch the status of a PR.
